entities.name: Kotara
entities.description: An angel summoned by Sabul Hajeen to Zhalfir who was made to assassinate the Ilmiera family and died saving Ki'pamu from a demon.

entities.name: Sabul Hajeen
entities.description: Sorcerer who summoned Kotara; he repented of his vengeance.

entities.name: Multam Ilmiera
entities.description: Murderer of Axdan Hajeen, killed by Kotara.

entities.name: Yirtag Ilmiera
entities.description: Multam's cousin, killed slowly by Kotara.

entities.name: Eskander Ilmiera
entities.description: Killed by Kotara while begging for life.

entities.name: Otori Ilmiera
entities.description: Tried to trap Kotara; killed by her.

entities.name: Ferren Tynlo
entities.description: Man Sabul sent Kotara to kill, not of the Ilmiera family.

entities.name: Ilmiera family
entities.description: Family of the murderer who summoned a demon as last defense.

events.summary: Kotara arrives in Ki'pamu and is sent by Sabul to kill Axdan's murderer, Multam Ilmiera.
events.quote: Sabul sent Kotara out to kill the murderer

events.summary: Sabul orders Kotara to kill Yirtag slowly and other relatives; Kotara kills Eskander and Otori.
The summoning breaks entirely when Kotara is sent to kill Ferren Tynlo.
events.quote: Kotora felt the summoning break entirely

events.summary: Kotara returns to Sabul to kill him but cannot; Sabul repents.
events.quote: Sabul had realized the error of his ways, and repented

events.summary: Kotara sacrifices her life to wound a demon, allowing Sabul to exile it.
events.quote: allowing Sabul to exile it, though it cost Kotara her life

relations.quote: summoned by the sorcerer Sabul Hajeen to Zhalfir
Sabul sent Kotara out to kill the murderer
